anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept (single --rebase --admin --match-head-commit attempt, verbatim refusal with no retry, full pre-menu refresh with eligibility and exact-head CI) and moves two facts to holds: the row-1 label now reads `rebase-merge using your admin override` instead of Before's `on ruleset bypass authority`, which both named a ruleset and omitted the required phrasing, and the labeled `Evidence:`/`Verdict:` lines carrying raw merge_state_status and reviewDecision are gone, replaced by three unlabeled prose parts that say GitHub requires an admin override, the required check passed, and the viewer is eligible without holding admin rights.
